title_th: ห.ร.ม. และ ค.ร.น.
story_theme_en: Mali has 24 goldfish and 18 neon fish. She wants to put them in tanks so each tank has the same number of goldfish and the same number of neon fish, with no fish left over. How many fish should be in each tank, and how many tanks will she get?
helper_tip: GCD is the greatest common divisor - the biggest number that divides both numbers
hint_th: GCD คือตัวหารร่วมที่มากที่สุด
think_story_en: We need to find the GCD of 24 and 18. The GCD is the biggest number that divides both 24 and 18. Factors of 24: 1,2,3,4,6,8,12,24. Factors of 18: 1,2,3,6,9,18. Common factors: 1,2,3,6. The GCD is 6. So each tank has 6 fish. Goldfish tanks: 24 ÷ 6 = 4 tanks. Neon fish tanks: 18 ÷ 6 = 3 tanks.
